title: ADJUDICATE (human): R-02a-003 Rule 0x08 TDMA_BEACON — implement compression rule vs amend spec to uncompressed header
description: Child of b7z9.21 (spec-coverage sweep, R-02a-003 MUST). Decision needed from Mark: spec/02a 2a.2 says 'The root advertises epoch (u32) and num_slots (default 8) via SCHC Rule ID 0x08 (TDMA_BEACON) on CH0', but Rule 0x08 exists in NO implementation (Python rules.py, Rust rules.rs RULE_SET_V3, C schc.c 'rules 0-7 + fallback') and no vectors; all three implementations instead carry TDMA beacons as an uncompressed fixed header (rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs:21-26,83-126) with cross-implementation parity. spec/appendix-schc.md rule table (lines 24-35) lacks 0x08; spec Implementation Status line ~685 claims 0x08 implemented — false today. Evidence for AMEND-SPEC (recommended): divergence is uniform and deliberate; beacons are rare root-originated infrastructure frames so compression buys little; implementing a new rule needs shared vectors + 3 engines + parity for marginal gain; uncompressed header already interop-tested. Evidence for IMPLEMENT: R-02a-003 is a MUST; CH0 beacon cadence could still benefit; appendix rule-table headroom exists. Either way the false Implementation Status claim must be corrected. After adjudication: if AMEND, do the doc slice (spec 2a.2 + appendix + status line); if IMPLEMENT, file python/rust/C + vectors slices.
close_reason: Re-closing (sync loop overwrote). Adjudicated option B.
